versions.text: (a) A 90º cross component of wind velocity, demonstrated to be safe for take-off and landing, must be established for dry runways and must be at least 37 km/h (20 kt) or 0·2 VSR0, whichever is greater, except that it need not exceed 46 km/h (25 kt).

(a) The following applies:
  (1) A 90º cross component of wind velocity, demonstrated to be safe for take-off and landing, must be established for dry runways and must be at least 37 km/h (20 kt) or 0·2 VSR0, whichever is greater, except that it need not exceed 46 km/h (25 kt).
  (2) The crosswind component for takeoff established without ice accretions is valid in icing conditions.
  (3) The landing crosswind component must be established for:
    (i) Non-icing conditions, and
    (ii) Icing conditions with the landing ice accretion defined in appendix C.

  (2) The crosswind component for takeoff established without ice accretions is valid in icing conditions.
  (3) The landing crosswind component must be established for:
    (i) Non-icing conditions, and
    (ii) Icing conditions with the most critical of the landing ice accretion(s) defined in Appendices C and O, as applicable, in accordance with CS 25.21(g).
